subject: DPIA support & Art.28/30 evidence — Orchard Bank onboarding
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@orchardbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Compliance Team <compliance@orchardbank.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-06-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: DPIA & Art.28/30 evidence for onboarding

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the guided walkthrough last week. As part of Orchard Bank's onboarding checklist we need a compact package to feed our DPIA and legal review teams. Specifically they asked for:

- A short dataflow snapshot (ingress points, regions, processors) reflecting current production routing.
- Subprocessor map (Art. 28) and any recent changes in the last 12 months.
- Confirmation of transfer mechanisms (SCCs/adequacy decisions) used for EU->US processing.
- Any DPIA support notes you can share (sample findings, mitigations).

We're aiming to complete the internal approval by 2025-06-10. Could you confirm what you can share under our NDA and provide a target delivery date? Ideally we need something we can attach directly to our DPIA draft.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Senior Legal Counsel, Orchard Bank
maria.gomez@orchardbank.com

---
Attachment: orchard_dpia_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@orchardbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-01T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: DPIA & Art.28/30 evidence for onboarding

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front and then a plan: 

1) We can provide a dataflow snapshot and a machine-readable subprocessor map.
2) For transfers we typically rely on SCCs (2021 standard clauses) plus our internal legitimate safeguards — we will include the specific SCC addenda used and a short explanatory note.
3) DPIA support: Marissa will draft a ~1-page summary of risks & mitigations tailored to banking workloads.

Plan: Marissa and Irene will assemble the artifacts, we’ll run them by legal for redaction, and share a secured Drive link. Can we deliver a first bundle by 2025-06-03 EOD? If you need earlier, say so.

On scope: are there any special retention or residency carve-outs we should model in the snapshot? (e.g., some endpoints must stay in eu-west-1)

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-02T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: DPIA & Art.28/30 evidence for onboarding

Hi Maria / Jordan — looping in the privacy team for the artifact list. We will prepare the following bundle and mark any fields that should be redacted for privacy/security reasons:

- art28-30_subprocessor_map.csv (machine-readable list: role, vendor, country, processing purpose, contractual basis, last updated)
- dataflow_snapshot_20250531.jsonl (annotated flow showing ingress, egress, KV cache points, transient stores)
- DPIA-support-summary.pdf (1 page, risk categories and mitigations)
- SCCs_and_addenda.pdf (redacted copies of the standard contractual clauses and our addendum template)
- sample logs extract (metadata-only) — for audit trail evidence we will provide a small, sanitized sample.

A couple of clarifying questions for Orchard Bank to make sure the artifacts meet legal review expectations: 
- Do you require copies of any third-party attestations (SOC 2) in the same package, or do you prefer those referenced with links to vendor portals?
- For transfers: will you accept SCCs + our Transfer Impact Assessment, or do you require an alternative such as onshore processing commitments?

We will stage the package on a secure Drive folder and provide a HubSpot ticket reference so your team can track delivery. Target: first bundle by 2025-06-03 17:00 UTC.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Manager, Redwood Inference
Marissa.Cole@redwood.com
